messages:
Ivy: hi all — ivy here (backend), day 2. trying to inspect a prod feature flag in Console to trace a payment flow bug but getting a 403 on GET /admin/flags/payments-rollback. who handles quick read access or a JIT?

Mark: welcome @Ivy! :wave: we separate read vs write. read-only views are ff-auditors, writes are ff-operators. do you need to toggle or just pull audit lines?

Ivy: just read audits + current state to map to a failing request id. prefer a 1-hour read window so i can run a script.

Sofia: we typically do a JIT for that. open a Linear ticket with purpose + expiry and i'll sponsor. include the exact curl you used so ops can reproduce the 403 if needed.

infra-ops-bot: access-request template: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/access-requests. Select: "jit-elevation" or "service-account-readonly".

Ivy: filed ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PROD-9999 — reason: snapshot prod flag state for payments rollback investigation; expiry 60m.

Sofia: approving now. note: approval will prompt for MFA and the system will attach an audit id automatically.

infra-ops-bot: JIT created: JIT-9999. Approver: Sofia. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/jit/JIT-9999

Ivy: fyi the curl i ran before approval:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/admin/flags/payments-rollback
# response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","code":"FF_NO_ACCESS"}
```

infra-ops-bot: JIT approved. Ivy granted ff-auditors-prod for 60 minutes. Audit ref: AUD-2026-03-22-9999

Ivy: can confirm i can now fetch the audit entries and flag state. saved snapshot to the Linear ticket and included the audit id. not changing any flags.

Mark: great. quick tip: if this becomes a recurring check, ask for a CI-triggered JIT instead of a long-lived token. less compliance friction.

Sofia: and for future toggles prefer a canary percentage rollout rather than a full flip when testing with prod traffic.

Ivy: will do — thanks so much for the quick help! excited to be here :smile:
